topic.title: Comment Against Comment, Same Range
topic.shortdesc: Both reviewers comment on exactly the same ranges. The document text is never touched.

section.title: Configuring the service
section.p: The configuration file is read once, at startup. Restart the service after every change.
The signing key is loaded at startup and cached for the whole life of the process.
section.note: Never commit the signing key to the repository.

ol.li: Edit conf/auth-service.properties and set the signing key.
